$comment: Toolchain and runtime pins for Sigil's native runtime packs (read by build-runtime-packs.ps1; see README.md). Owned by P1-D1.

Engine versions live in native/engines/<name>/engine.json (each engine's workstream owns its folder); catalog pins live in src-tauri/model-catalog/*.json. This file only holds what the build machine needs.

toolchain.generator_note: CMake's default generator (the newest Visual Studio) with -A x64; pass -Generator Ninja from a Developer PowerShell for CUDA builds without the CUDA Visual Studio integration.

cuda13.note: CUDA 13 supports Turing (sm_75) and newer only; the NVIDIA runtime pack provides cudart64_13 / cublas64_13 at run time (never bundled in an engine pack).

vulkan.note: Set VULKAN_SDK. The Vulkan loader (vulkan-1.dll) comes with every GPU driver; nothing Vulkan-related is packed.

ort_cuda_provider.note: The provider is taken byte-identical from the ort-sys build (src-tauri/target/<profile>) or pyke's dist cache (%LOCALAPPDATA%/ort.pyke.io/dfbin/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/<pyke_dist>/) and must match the sha256 pinned in the catalog.
